assumptions: Weight uses the record's topology and strand count; ambiguity codes are broken out rather than resolved.
limits: Composition only: it says nothing about what the sequence does.
A weight over ambiguous bases is reported as a range or excluded, never silently averaged.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: The answer is the record's computed composition (weight, GC and AT, the per-symbol census), which the outputs carry; the Properties panel shows them as readouts and writes no reading over them.
bio.jane/contract.question: What is this record made of: molecular weight under its own topology, GC and AT, and the per-symbol census?

description: What the subject record is MADE OF: molecular weight under its own topology and strand count, GC and AT over the resolved bases, and the per-symbol census with the ambiguity codes broken out. The nucleic-acid counterpart of `protein_properties`, and the same derivation the editor's Properties panel, its inspector and the alignment inspector all draw (Biopython's mass model; ProtParam for a protein subject).

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

doubleStranded.description: weigh BOTH strands (a plasmid or any dsDNA record) rather than the one strand written in the file (an oligo, an RNA, an alignment row). The two answers differ by about a factor of two, which is why it is a parameter and not a guess. Defaults to true, or false when the record is RNA (U and no T), which is also weighed with RNA residue masses.

name: record_composition

atPercent.description: percent A+T over the same denominator. Null for a protein

composition.description: one row per standard symbol: code, label, count, and its percent of `standardCount`

extinction.description: protein subjects only: e280 under both cystine conventions; null otherwise

gcPercent.description: percent G+C over the RESOLVED A/C/G/T bases (`standardCount`), which is Biopython's gc_fraction default (ambiguous="remove") — not over the full length, so it complements `atPercent` exactly. Null for a protein

isoelectricPoint.description: protein subjects only (ProtParam, Bjellqvist); null otherwise

length.description: symbols in the record, non-standard ones included

molecularWeight.description: molecular weight — g/mol for a nucleic acid under `doubleStranded` and the record's own topology, Da for a protein

nonStandard.description: the symbols the alphabet does not define — Ns, IUPAC ambiguity codes, gaps — with counts and NO share, because they are excluded from the denominator

standardCount.description: how many of `length` are standard — the denominator every share here is over

strands.description: how many strands the mass was taken over: 2, 1, or 0 for a protein where the question does not arise
